mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates on future corporate earnings and increasing the present value of equities, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate above 6.5% over a 3-month window signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer confidence and future spending, which depresses corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the UNRATE threshold being breached, or the signal's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in residential construction permits (HOUST) and personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) indicates strong underlying demand momentum, which signals robust corporate revenue growth and positive equity market sentiment, driving S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint increase in HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 60-day SPX returns in > 60% of instances, or the interaction term's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95.0 for two consecutive months signals weakening supply chain activity and reduced manufacturing output, which increases recession risk and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during INDPRO contraction periods (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rebound in real GDP (GDPC1) following a contraction, combined with rising residential construction (HOUST), indicates a recovery in aggregate demand, which boosts corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth rate turns positive after two consecutive negative quarters
failure_condition: The combined signal of positive GDPC1 growth and rising HOUST fails to generate positive 60-day SPX returns in > 60% of cases, or the interaction term's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the CPIAUCSL above 2.5% year-over-year, combined with a stable or rising federal funds rate, signals persistent inflationary pressure, prompting the Fed to maintain or tighten policy, which increases real rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during high-CPI, high-FEDFUNDS regimes (t-test p > 0.05), or the interaction term's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5.0% while employment growth (PAYEMS) exceeds 200k per month signals a tight labor market, increasing wage pressures and inflation expectations, which leads to higher discount rates and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 5.0% and PAYEMS growth > 200k in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative during triggered instances (t-test p > 0.05), or the interaction term's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption (RSAFS) above its 12-month moving average, combined with rising residential construction (HOUST), indicates strong consumer demand and housing market momentum, which supports corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising RSAFS and HOUST fails to produce positive 20-day SPX returns in > 60% of cases, or the interaction term's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
